description: ISO week calendar. No input: the current ISO 8601 week number and week-numbering year, the Monday-Sunday span of the week, the 52/53-week year shape, the weeks elapsed and remaining, and the ISO day of week, answered fresh on every call. Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: iso-week
